key_insight: Stochastic transport models connect physically grounded uncertainty representation with rigorous analysis, data-driven calibration and high-dimensional Bayesian inference for geophysical flows.
engineering_relevance: This framework supports uncertainty quantification and forecasting in ocean and other geophysical fluid models.
method: Establish well-posedness, regularity and approximation theory using geometric and stochastic formulations.
Calibrate stochastic transport structures from observations and high-resolution simulations.
Develop Bayesian data assimilation using particle filters and machine-learning uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes theoretical and methodological developments and identifies calibration data sources, but reports no quantitative benchmarks or forecast improvements.
watch_item: Practical scalability and forecasting gains in high-dimensional applications require validation beyond the evidence reported in the abstract.
paper_title: From Stochastic Transport Models to High-Dimensional Bayesian Inference
